description_en: Retrieves the current parameters and template information for a specified application and its components
description_zh: 获取指定应用及其组件的当前参数和模板信息
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-application-parameters --application-id pa-00000000000000 --component-id-list pac-00000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApplicationParameters

parameters.help_en: A list of subcomponent IDs. If you specify this parameter, the operation returns the parameters and parameter templates for only these components
parameters.help_zh:
子组件ID列表，
传入则只返回这些组件的参数和参数模版
parameters.name: component_id_list
